docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF OCT-27-2016 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF OCT-27-2016 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF SHELLEY ESTRIDGE. APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT SIDNEY HORNE WITH SPOUSE ELLERY HORNE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: S. LE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-27-2016 - JUDGMENT. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: S. LE. NOT REPORTED. (506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ESTRIDGE, SHELLEY RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT HORNE, SIDNEY $9,360.00 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $9,360.00, DEFENDANT SHALL RECEIVE A CREDIT AGAINST THE JUDGMENT IN THE AMOUNT OF $1,320.00 AN AMOUNT WHICH DEFENDANT HAS ALREADY PAID TO PLAINTIFF. IMMEDIATELY UPON THE EFFECTIVE DATE OF THIS JUDGMENT DEFENDANT SHALL PROVIDE SEPARATE GAS AND ELECTRIC METERS FOR EACH TENANT'S DWELLING UNIT OR THE DEFENDANT SHALL ARRANGE TO BE MADE THE CUSTOMER OF RECORD WITH THE UTILITY FOR THE TENANTS METER. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
